UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile record stored per user UID. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

name.description: Display name of the user (1 to 100 chars).

email.description: Verified email address of the user (3 to 150 chars).

authProvider.description: Authentication provider used to sign in.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was first created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Journey.title: Journey
Journey.description: Completed navigation journey record owned by an authenticated user. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

userId.description: UID of the user who completed the journey.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the journey was saved via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the journey was updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Hazard.title: Hazard
Hazard.description: Active road or bridge hazard alert synced in real time. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

name.description: Display name of the road or bridge hazard.

type.description: Hazard type identifier (e.g. BRIDGE_DAMAGE, FLOODING, CONSTRUCTION).

severity.description: Hazard severity level (e.g. CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW).

active.description: Whether the hazard is currently active.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the hazard was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the hazard was updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user profile documents strictly isolated to the authenticated owner.

/journeys/{journeyId}.description: User navigation journey history strictly isolated by userId.

/hazards/{hazardId}.description: Real-time road and bridge hazards readable by authenticated users when active == true.
